definitions: Be deprived of or cease to have or retain (something).
Become unable to find (something or someone).
Suffer the loss of a game, contest, or argument.
Fail to win (a game or contest).
Gradually cease to have (a quality or ability).
Allow (something) to escape or be taken away.
Be defeated in a contest or game.
examples: I don't want to lose you.
He is going to lose his job.
They are expected to lose the game.
She tends to lose her temper easily.
We need to lose some weight.
